alt: March 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of seven friends in white, laughing and waving, splashed with Holi colours around a large “S+91”. Holi and Id-ul-Fitr are marked.
caption: A watercolor illustration of a joyful group celebrating Holi with colorful powder above a calendar for March 2025.
description: A vibrant watercolor style illustration shows a large group of people laughing and raising their hands, covered in a swirl of colorful powder. The artwork is set against a white background with large text reading S+91. Below the illustration is a partial calendar grid for the month of March 2025, with specific dates highlighted in red as 14 Holi and 31 Id-ul-Fitr.
